EO-015.title: Clean surface mould off tile, grout or caulk

items.name: Mould-resistant caulk
items.query: mold resistant kitchen and bath caulk

steps: Open a window or run the fan, and put on gloves.
Spray the remover on the grout and caulk and leave it for the time on the label. Don't mix it with other cleaners.
Scrub the grout lines with the brush, rinse, and dry the area.
If the caulk is still stained, cut it out and run a new line of mould-resistant caulk. Let it cure before you use the shower.

EO-047.title: Replace the smoke and carbon monoxide detector

items.name: Smoke and carbon monoxide detector
items.query: combination smoke and carbon monoxide detector 10 year sealed battery

steps: Fit the new detector where the old one was, on the ceiling or high on the wall outside the bedrooms.
Switch it on and hold the test button until the alarm sounds.
